name: Band Crunch
cardText:
Band Crunch
Intermediate
1
Place the band at the highest anchor point you have available. Grab both ends of the band and fall into a kneeling position.
2
Push your hips back flexing at the spine.
3
Squeeze your abs and then extend at the hips and spine back to the starting position.

name: Mini Band Leg Raise
cardText:
Mini Band Leg Raise
Novice
1
Loop band around ankles, lie flat on back.
2
Raise both legs upward, keeping them straight.
3
Lower slowly without arching lower back.

name: Mini Band Walking Mountain Climber
cardText:
Mini Band Walking Mountain Climber
Novice
1
Loop band around feet, start in high plank.
2
Step one foot forward under torso.
3
Alternate steps continuously, keeping hips stable.

name: Mini Band Mountain Climber
cardText:
Mini Band Mountain Climber
Beginner
1
Loop band around feet, start in high plank.
2
Drive one knee toward chest against resistance.
3
Alternate legs quickly while keeping hips stable.

name: Mini Band Around The World Plank
cardText:
Mini Band Around The World Plank
Beginner
1
Loop band around wrists, hold high plank position.
2
Move one hand forward, outward, then back in circular pattern.
3
Alternate sides, keeping hips level and core braced.

name: Mini Band Scissor Kick
cardText:
Mini Band Scissor Kick
Novice
1
Loop band around ankles, lie on back.
2
Lift legs slightly off floor, core braced.
3
Alternate legs in controlled scissor motion.

name: Mini Band Plank Hand Step Out
cardText:
Mini Band Plank Hand Step Out
Novice
1
Loop band around wrists, hold high plank.
2
Step one hand outward against band tension.
3
Return and alternate, keeping hips level.

name: Mini Band Plank Step Out
cardText:
Mini Band Plank Step Out
Novice
1
Loop band around ankles, hold high plank.
2
Step one foot outward, resisting band pull.
3
Return and alternate, maintaining stable hips.
